$comment: Generated from BundleManifest in src/bundle/types.ts by `pnpm schema:update`; don't edit. manifest.json at the root of a reeval bundle archive, read by reeval run --bundle.
title: BundleManifest

BundleArgs.description: The `reeval run` arguments a bundle replays: what shapes its plan.

argv.description: The command line `reeval bundle` was given, after `bundle`.

filters.description: Its filters, a path one relative to the project directory.

profile.description: The profile the plan ran under, which `--profile`, `REEVAL_PROFILE` or `defaultProfile` picked.

BundleEnvFile.description: A `.env` file the run loads, which the bundle leaves out.

path.description: Relative to the bundle root, with `/`.

variables.description: The variables it defines, sorted; never their values.

BundleFile.description: One file in the bundle, by its path in the archive.

kind.description: What it is to the run: a kind from the dry run's `inputs` (`eval`, `skill`, `lockfile`, …), or `install` for a file the install from the lockfile reads (`package.json`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, …).

path.description: Relative to the bundle root, with `/`.

BundleGit.description: The project's git state when it was bundled, as the run record's `git` keeps it.

diffHash.description: sha256 of the uncommitted changes as a binary patch, when dirty.

dirty.description: Uncommitted changes outside `.reeval/`; the bundle carries the changed files.

remote.description: The `origin` URL with any credentials removed.

BundleLink.description: A symbolic link in a skill or plugin folder, carried as a link to a file or folder in the bundle.

path.description: Relative to the bundle root, with `/`.

target.description: What it links to, relative to its own folder, with `/`; always inside the bundle.

author.description: Who the run belongs to, as the bundling machine named it: its git user, or `ci` in CI.

config.description: The config file, relative to the bundle root.

envFiles.description: The `.env` files the run loads, left out of the archive.

files.description: Every file in the archive but `manifest.json`, sorted by path.

git.description: The project's git state when it was bundled, which a run from the bundle records as its own (the extracted copy has no history); null outside git.

links.description: The symbolic links in the archive, sorted by path; absent when it has none.

plan.description: The `reeval run --dry-run --json` document the bundle was made from. Its shape is the reeval version's that wrote it, so it's kept as data: `reeval run --bundle` compares it with its own dry run.

project.description: The project directory, relative to the bundle root (`''` when they're the same): the root is the project's, or its git repository's when the project reads files outside its own directory or its lockfile is the repository's, as in a monorepo.

secrets.description: The host variables the run reads secrets from, as the dry run's `secrets`; never values.
